Atiq Ahmed's son Abaan buried near father's grave; brothers attended funeral

Abaan Ahmed, the youngest son of gangster-turned-politician Atiq Ahmed, was buried near his father's grave in Prayagraj. His brothers, Umar and Ali, who were on parole, carried Abaan's coffin and participated in the funeral prayers. The funeral saw a large crowd. Abaan's mother was reportedly absent from the last rites. Umar and Ali returned to jail after the burial.
